result:
The REQ-S12-019 fix is in: the operational-exception detail now shows the KPI's last known value and date as Stale while a later reporting period is open. The full integration run still exited 1, with 4 of 4084 tests failing in files this fix doesn't touch (details below).

The historical DG5 validator passed (exit 0) before any implementation.

**The fix.** `linkedKpiStatus` in `apps/api/src/modules/operations/exceptions.ts` now reads the KPI's latest open or closed period that has a value, instead of the organization's newest period. It uses the same per-period read and read-time freshness rule as the KPI panel. Authorization, the panel's own default period and the worker are unchanged. A KPI with no value in any period still shows Unknown with nulls, never 0.

**Starting state.** The killed earlier run of this task left a draft of this fix in the WIP commit `701005a40`. I reviewed it against ADR-0053 §2 and the contract, kept it, and only formatted it (uncommitted). Diff the repair against `701005a40~1`.

**New test.** `apps/api/test/integration/operations/exception-last-known-value.test.ts` has 8 tests against a disposable PostgreSQL. It opens later periods (one empty, one with an Unknown evaluation, one scheduled with a value), checks parity with the KPI panel, and covers authorization both ways. Run against the old code, 3 of the 8 fail; with the fix, all 8 pass.

**Checks** (logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-BE-X4-evidence/`):

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck` | 0 | |
| `pnpm -r build` | 0 | |
| `pnpm lint` | 0 | |
| Prettier, whole repo (run last) | 0 | |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 | |
| A17 QA integration file (unedited) | 0 | 10/10 |
| A17 e2e, en and ar (unedited) | 0 | 2 passed |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | 0 | 2769 + 2013 + 259 passed (2 skipped) |
| `pnpm test`, C.UTF-8, first run | 1 | Every test passed, but Vitest reported a worker timeout ("Timeout calling onTaskUpdate") while the integration suite was running alongside |
| `pnpm test`, C.UTF-8, rerun | 0 | Same counts, no errors |
| `pnpm test:integration` (full) | 1 | 4077 passed, 4 failed, 1 skipped, 2 todo, of 4084 |

**The four integration failures:**
- **Two 30-second timeouts**, in `contract.test.ts` and `response-validation.test.ts`. Both files pass in full when rerun alone, so this looks like machine load.
- **One P5 BE-J dependency-slip check** (`p5-exercises-be-j.ts:61`) also passed on the solo rerun. It looks unstable under load, and its owner should look at it.
- **One real failure, already on the integrated base:** `admin/security.test.ts` expects the webhook rate-limit class to list no operations. It now lists `receiveWebhook`, which BE-N added. It fails on its own too, and the test's owner needs to update that expectation. I left it alone because the assignment says to change no other behaviour.

**Assignment items:**
- **Migrations:** none needed.
- **Endpoints and pending operations:** I added no endpoints and moved no pending operations (there's no `p6-pending-be-x4.ts` list). Route counts in `contract.test.ts` are unchanged.
- **Contract, schema and dependencies:** no changes needed.
- **User-facing text:** the existing admin intro ("Linked KPIs keep their last known value and are labelled Stale") was untrue before this fix and is true now, so no string needed editing.

**Decision for the BE-K2 owner:** the worker's freshness scan (`kpiFreshness` in `apps/worker/src/handlers/operations.ts`) still reads only the newest period. When a later period is open and empty, it sees the KPI as Unknown rather than Stale, so it won't open a new stale-data exception. The failing-connector case doesn't depend on it. Whether the scan should use the same last-known-value rule is that owner's decision, so I didn't change it.

The changes are left uncommitted. Timing: 04:12 to 06:17 UTC, past the 100-minute mark because the full integration suite alone took 85 minutes.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/`:
- T-DG6-BE-X4-backend-workflow-engineer.md
- T-DG6-BE-X4-evidence/
